text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"multi-paragraph argument with topic sentences and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"It presents ideas in a clearer overall structure, with separate reasons developed across paragraphs and a concluding wrap-up."},{"evidence":"“Another reason… One other major reason… another reason…”","quality":"cohesion","description":"It uses repeated linking phrases and transitions to connect points and move the argument forward more smoothly."},{"evidence":"“focus on there academics,” “save up for a higher education,” “work expires”","quality":"development","description":"It gives more extended explanation and multiple supporting reasons rather than brief, repetitive statements."},{"evidence":"“stressful trying to put a 4 year education in 3 years,” “retake important quizzes or test”","quality":"specific support","description":"It includes more concrete examples that elaborate the argument and make the ideas more fully grounded."},{"evidence":"“available,” “challaging,” “involved”","quality":"vocabulary range","description":"It shows a somewhat wider range of academic and argument-related word choices, even though some are misspelled."}]}
